detail: Add Node on Edge Drop Demo

checks.name: overview: 11 nodes and 6 edges render
overview: minimap + controls + background present
overview: pointer drag moves Default Node (on_nodes_change -> State.set_nodes)
overview: toolbar button sets State.emoji (🔥 shown in tools node)
overview: × on a button edge removes it (run_script set_edges)
overview: 'Node width' input resizes node 2-3 via State.set_dimensions
checks.detail: z-index: 1; transform: translate(80px, 300px); pointer-events: all; visibility: visible; width: 120px; height: 80px;

checks.name: overview: Backspace deletes the selected Output Node
overview: controls zoom-in changes the viewport transform
overview: after reload the moved position, deleted node and emoji persist (session state)
add-node-on-edge-drop: dropping a connection on the pane adds Node 1 + an edge (on_connect_end + screen_to_flow_position)
add-node-on-edge-drop: second drop adds Node 2
add-node-on-edge-drop: a new session starts with only the initial node (no cross-session leak of default_factory list)
connection-limit: Node 1 -> custom target handle creates an edge
connection-limit: second connection to the same handle is refused (is_connectable from get_node_connections)
custom-node: color input -> State.on_change_color updates node label
custom-node: background bg_color follows State
custom-node: minimap node_color (ArgsFunctionOperation + rx.match on State var) uses the new color
custom-node: on_connect adds an animated edge (connection.merge({animated: true}))
drag-handle: dragging the label text does not move the node
drag-handle: dragging the custom handle moves the node (uncontrolled default_nodes)
intersections: dragging node over Node 3 highlights it (on_node_drag throttle + get_intersecting_nodes)

notes: overview: Output Node shows .selected after click (controlled nodes round trip)
